messages:
amelia: Hey all — quick quarterly OKR check-in thread. I pulled the milestones for Q2 -> Q3 handoff. Please post 2-line status: (1) what shipped, (2) what slipped or blocked, (3) next owner + ETA. Keep it short so PMs can aggregate.

laura: Hosting/Hosted API OKR: shipped the streaming v2 endpoint and usage meter updates. slipped: rate-limit UI polish (UX bug) — blocks self-serve upgrades. owner: @ryan to coordinate w/ @marta on backend fix. ETA: EOW. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

ryan: Confirming — backend fix is identified (race in token bucket). I'll open PR today, @marta can you review infra risk? ETA for merge + rollout Thu.

marta: I'll review the PR today. infra concern is rolling limits to Dedicated clusters; will add canary config and autoscale watch. If all green, we can promote by Fri.

niko: Model onboarding OKR: shipped quantized 4-bit baseline for redwood-lite and perf profiles published. slipped: eval harness for reg tests (some flaky evals on long prompts). owner: @niko + @devon to stabilize. ETA: next week.

devon: I'll help repro the flakies — looks like RNG seed + tokenization mismatch in one eval. Quick fix available, running CI now. Will post logs.

amelia: Private/VPC OKR: what's the status on air-gapped installer? We promised enterprise pilot this month.

marta: Installer prototype is in staging, but customer-specific KMS integrations are pending (two vendors). slipped from target due to cert rotation flow. owner: @marta + security. ETA for pilot: 2 weeks unless KMS vendor delays.

laura: Dedicated capacity OKR: shipped committed instance billing and burst policy. slipped: cross-region failover test (need SRE signoff). owner: @devon. ETA: next sprint.

devon: Adding the cross-region failover test to oncall window. We need a short maintenance window to simulate AZ loss; proposing next Tue 02:00-03:00 UTC. Will notify customers via status page and the incident bot.

amelia: Eval/regression alerts OKR: status? We had auto-alerts tied to prompt sets.

niko: Alerts are live but noisy. We reduced false positives by 40% after threshold tuning; remaining noise comes from low-volume customers. Plan: add per-customer thresholds + page only on P1 regressions. owner: @niko. ETA: two weeks for rollout.

ryan: Quick note on dependencies: the runtime kernel selector change (ENG-RUN-214) is blocked on the quantization PR (ENG-ML-98). Once merged, we can flip the feature flag. owner: @ryan + @niko. ETA: 5 working days post-merge.

laura: Customer-facing docs: shipped quickstart for streaming. slipped: dedicated deploy runbook needs step-by-step for ops teams. owner: @laura + @marta. ETA: Fri.

amelia: Risks: 1) KMS delays for Private pilot 2) Cross-region failover pending signoff 3) Eval flakiness could mask regressions. If any owner needs unblock help, ping me directly.

ryan: FYI I'll drop a short PR with a mitigation (temporary rate-limit UI fallback) so self-serve isn't blocked while UX gets polished.

marta: Noted. Also enabling extra observability for the rate-limiter path to watch for regressions.

devon: deploy-bot: scheduled maintenance notification posted to #status and will send an update 1 hour before the test.

deploy-bot: [automated] maintenance scheduled: Cross-region failover test on Tue 02:00 UTC. Contact oncall@redwood to opt-out.

laura: Can each owner paste the checklist link for their milestone so PMs can update the delta doc?

niko: Checklist: https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/model-onboard-q3. Quick items ticked there.

ryan: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/812 — includes token-bucket fix and deploy notes.

marta: Infra checklist (staging -> prod): https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/infra-dedicated-checklist. I added canary steps.

amelia: Great — I'll compile these into the OKR tracker. Last ask: if anything slips further, update the tracker and mention impact to SLA or pilot timelines. Thanks all :tada:
